subject: Expansion: new project pools, billing delta & rollout plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@harborone.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request: three new teams + billing question

Hi Sergio —

Quick note after our internal sync this morning: HarborOne wants to expand Redwood usage to three additional product teams (Search, Checkout, Insights). The teams will be separate projects, and they'll each need their own API keys and quota segmentation. High-level asks: 

- Can you confirm incremental per-token pricing for the next 12 months if we add ~3.5B generated tokens/month across the three teams?
- Lead time to provision keys and isolate logs per project (we prefer separate namespaces).
- Any impact to our existing committed capacity/credits or a recommended addendum approach.

If helpful, Marcus (cc'd) will be the procurement contact for contract language. We want to align on timeline — ideally keys and access by 8/20 so teams can begin a pilot week of integration.

Thanks —
Elena
Elena Rossi
VP, Platform Product
HarborOne Solutions
---
Attachment: product-teams-summary.pdf (summary only)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@harborone.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request: three new teams + billing question

Elena —

Appreciate the heads-up. We can absolutely support separate project namespaces and per-project API keys. Proposed immediate next steps: 

1) Internal kickoff (30 min) this week to capture exact SLAs/segmentation needs — Laura (CS lead) will run this.
2) Ben (Account) to provide a pricing delta and addendum template reflecting your committed + overage bands.
3) Procure signs addendum; we issue keys and enable namespaces (target 8/20 as requested).

Quick clarification requests: 
- When you say "isolate logs per project" — do you need a separate retention policy per project or just separate access controls?
- Any preference on key rotation windows (we can pre-provision and force rotate on first use).

I'll pull together a short estimate now and loop Ben; Laura / Ben — please add any constraints we should flag.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@harborone.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request: three new teams + billing question

Elena —

Thanks — attached is a compact estimate and rollout recommendation (attachment: HarborOne-Expansion-Estimate.xlsx). Summary below: 

- Usage profile (est.): 3.5B gen tokens/mo across 3 teams (avg 1.2B each; Search a bit higher).
- Recommended approach: Addendum to existing contract with a stepped commit for 12 months: 30% incremental commit for first 3 months (pilot), then move to full commit month 4.
- Pricing delta: blended incremental rate = $0.00185 per gen token (negotiated step-down at 6m if usage > planned).
- Keys & isolation: We will create three project namespaces, each with its own API key and IAM rules. Keys ready within 3 business days after addendum signed + procurement sign-off.
- Impact to credits: Current reserved capacity will be pro-rated; addendum will reflect credit allocation and any required top-up.

Suggested timeline:
- 8/11: kickoff call to align technical requirements
- 8/12-8/14: draft addendum and provide DocuSign
- 8/15: procurement review
- 8/18: sign & approve
- 8/19-8/20: keys provisioned and pilot begins

I've called out a small network egress note for the Checkout team — Laura, can you confirm whether HarborOne wants redaction-on-ingest for logs? That affects retention pricing.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: HarborOne-Expansion-Estimate.xlsx
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@harborone.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@harborone.ai>, procure@harborone.ai
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request: three new teams + billing question

Ben / Sergio —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. The numbers look reasonable. A few items from procurement: 

- Please send the addendum with explicit pro-rating math for existing credits.
- We will need the redaction-on-ingest option for Checkout (sensitive PII) — please include pricing for that as a line item.
- DocuSign is preferred; can you route to procure@harborone.ai.

We expect to sign quickly if the addendum includes clear effective dates and the keys turnaround time you noted.

Marcus Hale
Head of Procurement
HarborOne Solutions
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@harborone.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena@harborone.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request: three new teams + billing question

Marcus / Elena —

We're on the same page. Action items completed: 

- Ben uploaded the estimate and a first-pass addendum (HBO_Addendum_Draft.docx) to the shared Drive link above.
- HubSpot record: HS-3485921 (I've attached that to the deal and added notes).
- DocuSign will be sent to procure@harborone.ai by EOD today (link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-HBO-Addendum).
- Keys provisioning: We will pre-generate the three API keys and hold them in a staging state; keys will be rotated on first use and access scoped to project namespace. Expected issuance: within 48 hours of signed addendum.

Laura — please schedule the 8/11 kickoff (30 min) with Elena and Marcus; include a brief tech checklist (retention, key rotation cadence, redaction).

If there are any redline concerns once you preview the addendum, flag them directly to me so we can keep the 8/20 pilot start.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
